mode: READ-ONLY source audit; only assigned report and heartbeat written
purpose: Inspect selected vehicle signal history and live telemetry through aligned chart, numeric statistics and typed history rows.
primaryGoal: Select up to five signals, run a deliberate historical exploration in workspace scope or stream live, then inspect measurements and raw-row details.

dataSources.name: Vehicle signal catalog
dataSources.behavior: Typed catalog reduced to signal-name strings; request forwards AbortSignal. Rich value/unit metadata is not available to this page through this hook.

dataSources.name: Historical samples
dataSources.sourceOwner: signalHandler.History; router describes Postgres primary and optional fallback
dataSources.behavior: Explore stamp enables Promise.all per selected signal; adapters flatten rows, sort descending, calculate numeric-only statistics and client pagination. Query does not forward AbortSignal. Server limit/filter/fallback implementation is not inspected; bounded returned rows are not a complete-range total.

dataSources.name: Live telemetry
dataSources.behavior: Selected signals only; vehicle filtering when event supplies vehicle_id; 500ms event-driven flush; five-minute chart buffer; cumulative numeric aggregates and point counter; tail disabled via tailMax=0. Connection is not per-signal freshness.

issues.detail: Live icon and dot both constantly animate-pulse (also line 182). Ambient motion is unnecessary; shared CSS reduced-motion handling was not inspected here and cannot establish actual OS behavior.

states.initial: No selected vehicle produces a named prompt; before Explore the page shows unknown record count and actionable control guidance.
states.loading: History components receive historicalLoading and skeletons; Explore receives isFetching. Catalog selector receives [] during initial loading without a dedicated loading state.
states.empty: Empty histories retain sections and describe range/signal recovery; stats preserve selected no-numeric-data rows with non-finite placeholders.
states.fatalError: Catalog/history error banner; history panel SourceContent retry uses fatalError. Catalog initial failure banner lacks its own retry.
states.refreshError: useDataState and StaleRefreshWarning preserve successful history and catalog choices; source tests describe retained behavior but were not run.
states.liveOffline: Shared connection maps to connected/disconnected text; chart/stat buffers remain. No per-signal age/last-success state is passed.

issues.detail: availableSignals ?? [] conflates catalog loading with resolved empty choices. The fatal catalog banner at lines 277-281 is descriptive but has no retry action although catalogState provides one.
issues.fix: Compose existing source loading/empty/error recovery around the selector, preserving cached options and keeping independent history readable; provide catalogState.retry without duplicating a fetch.

issues.detail: TelemetrySummaryBrief supports loading but the page never passes it. First Explore immediately labels Historical while results are pending. Live metrics always expose a point count and numeric stats based on buffer state without sample freshness.
issues.fix: Pass history loading and preserve retained-data distinctions; represent live connection separately from source readiness/freshness using existing trust mechanisms, retaining an honest zero received-event count where meaningful.

visualIssues.detail: Signal identifiers are entire colored body labels using CHART_COLORS; history does the same at lines 137-151. Default is explicitly CB-safe, NOT the opt-in neon palette, but yellow/orange/saturated text repeats chart emphasis in dense rows and composed contrast is unknown.
visualIssues.fix: Keep readable signal text on text-primary/secondary tokens and retain a small consistent palette swatch for series correspondence. Reuse the shared palette owner; do not recolor raw identities or force-reset saved chart choices.

visualIssues.detail: Data type maps string to success and boolean to warning. These are representation types, not positive outcome or warning severity; repeated semantic colored badges amplify non-status metadata.
visualIssues.fix: Use neutral type-chip presentation with localized text; reserve severity colors for actual measured status. Preserve type distinctions and row detail.

visualIssues.detail: Live rendering is red danger-colored whether connected or disconnected, with red metadata at line 181. Connection text elsewhere supplies actual state but the live chart decoration does not reflect it.
visualIssues.fix: Keep ordinary live metadata muted/neutral and reserve semantic severity for actual disconnected/error state; retain readable mode and counts.

architectureIssues.detail: Page discards useRangeState.startInstant/endInstantExclusive and rebuilds calendar-midnight/inclusive-end timestamps. The shared hook explicitly provides precise Live/24h rolling instants (useRangeState:112-127). Registered header range therefore cannot retain rolling semantics in historical requests.
architectureIssues.fix: Consume canonical startInstant/endInstantExclusive and agreed API bound semantics through the existing typed hook; preserve Explore staging, custom/timezone/DST and full-server filtering. Confirm backend upper-bound inclusivity before changing the request.

architectureIssues.detail: Query key includes vehicle/explore stamp but not signals/range/size; queryFn closes over current controls. Editing controls without Explore leaves old payload labelled with current selectedSignals/scope, and background refetch may use new inputs under the old key. Existing summary context acknowledges configured versus executed dates but chart/stat identities still use current controls.
architectureIssues.fix: Capture an immutable executed-query descriptor on Explore and key the data by that descriptor; keep staged controls separate from executed labels and forward TanStack AbortSignal. Preserve deliberate execution and retained refresh behavior.

architectureIssues.detail: Promise.all makes one selected signal failure reject the whole history result; successful siblings cannot be presented as partial. Aggregate array does not expose pending/failed identities or per-signal retry.
architectureIssues.fix: Reuse existing per-signal evidence/data-state ownership rather than inventing another aggregator; retain all selected identities, successful histories and individual retry, and pass partial state through the summary.

architectureIssues.detail: Adapter retains timestamp/signal/typed value only. SignalHistoryPoint also declares kind, ingest_origin, source_emitted_at, received_at and normalization_version (api/types:2670-2678); response bounds/count also disappear in page flattening. Expanded JSON is the projected row, not the complete transport payload.
architectureIssues.fix: Retain typed source evidence alongside display projection and expose it through existing row detail/source-bound contracts; do not claim current JSON expansion preserves original provenance. Keep raw SI values intact.

architectureIssues.detail: Live chart uses parseFloat(String(val)) for any non-number/non-boolean signal; prefix-numeric strings can become measured numbers. Historical path keeps strings nonnumeric. Hook retains prior aggregates when selection changes while enabled (reset effect lines 140-143 only runs reset when !enabled).
architectureIssues.fix: Use existing typed signal metadata to distinguish numeric/boolean/string displays; never invent unit inference. Make selection/session aggregate identity explicit and test retained versus reset behavior without discarding historical raw strings.

architectureIssues.detail: Dual-axis choice compares the first two stats entries; stats order comes from row/arrival order, whereas right-axis assignment uses selectedSignals index 1 at line 273. These identities need not align and third-to-fifth disparate scales are not assessed.
architectureIssues.fix: Map range evidence by signal identity before assigning existing axes; preserve all series, gaps and accessible rows. Treat unknown unit compatibility as unknown rather than inventing conversion.

architectureIssues.detail: Domain page imports adapter/types from the component-root SignalQueryControls instead of a category or typed data utility owner. Pure projection is coupled to a file also containing unrelated older UI implementations.
architectureIssues.fix: Integrate projection/types into the existing telemetry data utility/category owner, preserving adapter behavior; do not adopt unrelated legacy UI exports.

dataBehavior: Typed raw SI transport/cache values must not be converted or replaced; generic signal labels/units require metadata evidence.
Numeric historical aggregates cover loaded samples only; booleans chart as 1/0 and strings remain history values.
History sorts descending; chart timestamps ascend; null gaps remain null and connectNulls=false.
Historical API result bound is per signal and client size*10; loaded count is never full server history.
Live chart keeps five minutes while numeric stats/count accumulate since reset; chart-only stream disables tail.
Changing selected vehicle resets history execution and live buffers.
Retained successful data survives refresh errors.
Stable URL parameter keys, table IDs and shared preference/auth/AI boundaries must survive.
Fixes to scope/provenance/query identity need explicit integration tests; source audit alone cannot certify equivalent backend semantics.
